@@U00242@@
They were red in the face, they got so warm,
And rested, breathless, arm in arm.
Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho!
And a hey-nonny-no!
Breast on breast soft lying!
“Keep your hands to yourself,” said she,
“T know how girls, young brides-to-be,
Are stood up by no-goods like you!”
But soon hed coaxed her to the side,
And the music rang out far and wide:
Yoo-hoo! Yoo-ho!
And a hey-nonny-no!
And the fiddler, he played too!

@@U00244@@
How good it is of you, Doctor,
not to scorn our holiday,
but come to mingle with us folk,
scholar that we know you are.
Take this, now, this jug,
this handsome jug,
filled at the tap with our freshest brew.
I give it to you with our wish
that it not only quench your thirst,
but every drop that it contains
should lengthen your life by another day.

@@U00246@@
Thank you, old man,
and health and happiness to you.

@@U00247@@
(The people gather round him.)

@@U00249@@
It’s kind of you, truly kind,
to visit us on this happy day.
In years gone by,
in very dark times,

@@U00242@@
他们脸色通红，浑身发热，
然后手臂挽着手臂，气喘吁吁地休息。
哟吼！哟呵！
还有一个嘿-老妈-不！
乳房对乳房柔软的躺着！
“把手放在自己身上，”她说，
“我不知道女孩们，年轻的准新娘，
都被你这样的废物放倒了！”
但很快他就把她哄到了一边，
音乐响彻四方：
哟吼！哟呵！
还有一个嘿-老妈-不！
还有小提琴手，他也演奏！

@@U00244@@
你真是太好了，医生，
不要蔑视我们的假期，
但来与我们民间交往，
我们知道您是学者。
现在，拿着这个，这个罐子，
这个帅气的壶，
在水龙头处注入我们最新鲜的啤酒。
我把它送给你，带着我们的愿望
它不仅可以解渴，
但它所包含的每一滴
应该可以让你的寿命再延长一天。

@@U00246@@
谢谢老哥，
祝您健康快乐。

@@U00247@@
（人们聚集在他周围。）

@@U00249@@
你真好，真好，
在这个快乐的日子来拜访我们。
在过去的岁月里，
在非常黑暗的时期，
